blocks.text: This pack adds a workflow and checklist. Manage the separate application in Settings > Upgrades > Advanced tools. Checking a box records your progress; it does not install or run anything.
Review the official application requirements, model terms and download sizes.
Choose application, model-cache and output locations with enough disk space.
Install the application and selected models from the official source after reviewing the download.
Save locations in Advanced tools and check the local connection or files.
Run a short test in the application and inspect the output.
Save the input, model, settings and output together for repeatable work.
